description: Wasserkraftwerke Kärnten is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.ktn.gv.at. Hydroelectric power plants, source: Water information system Carinthia. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Carinthia hydroelectric power stations" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Energiequellen. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
